To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the natural pre-image approach is a general and effective tool for studying image representations, and that several CNN layers have remarkable properties that are not obvious from the network structure or the training data.
(1) the representations of CNNs can be inverted with high accuracy, (2) they are sensitive to image statistics, and (3) they are sensitive also to image semantics.

(a) the natural pre-image is a general and useful concept for studying representations, (b) several representations are surprisingly easy to invert, and (c) deep representations are surprisingly easy, and often accurate, to invert.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the nature of deep image representations.
the question of how to understand the internal representation of deep CNNs.
a better understanding of deep CNNs and their relation to shallow representations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
while the CNN is indeed a black box, its inner workings are more interesting than we thought.
while CNNs are very effective at classification, the representations they produce are still not as well-understood as the ones they replaced.
while CNN representations are more powerful than earlier representations, their internal workings are not as simple as we would like.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to visualize the representations learned by deep neural networks in a natural way and to understand how they represent images.
we can now see what deep convolutional neural networks see.
, while deep CNNs are indeed more accurate than their shallow counterparts, they are also more complex and less interpretable, and that the gap between the two may be larger than we thought.
The main takeaway from our work is that
these representations, both shallow (HOG, bag of visual words) and deep (AlexNet, VGG), have strong visual semantics, and that this semantics can be visualized in several ways.
these visualizations are a powerful tool to understand the properties of representations, which we hope will lead to better ones in the future.
these representations, despite being highly abstract, are surprisingly well-organized and interpretable, and we hope that our visualizations help us to gain a better understanding of them.
